| | Folks, Back in 2022:
* I was defending what some experts considered the single most competitive House district in the country.
* I served on the January 6th Committee, seeking justice and accountability.
* Virginia had shifted right, electing a Republican governor in 2021.
* MAGA spent $6 million to buy my House seat.
* The national headwinds favored Republicans.

Now, in 2026:
* I’m the challenger in the most competitive House race in the country, rated a Toss-Up by Cook Political Report.
* Voting is already underway. One in five likely voters say they’ve already cast their ballot.
* The U.S. military is being exploited as a political prop, and servicemembers are being mistreated every day.
* Hampton Roads families are facing new economic hardships, with gas prices still rising.
* Virginia went blue in 2025.
* _The national headwinds favor us._

There are plenty of well-founded reasons to be confident about this race. **But I don’t count my chickens before they hatch. And these ones hatch in 8 days.** Here’s why.
* Four years ago, at almost exactly this point in the race, a pollster had Jen Kiggans and me tied. I lost by just over 3 points.
* **MAGA has topped their 2022 spending. They’ve flooded $8 million into VA-02 because they know this seat will decide the House majority.**

name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: The senator who wants your kids to be afraid
body:
Plus: Greg Cunningham in studio on why CD2 decides Congress| New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/LUFtg8bKUB2?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | | | | |
Three Democrats said the quiet part out loud this week. A sitting U.S. senator told college students she wants them afraid to take a job in the Trump administration. A podcaster said the left has to keep firing at JD Vance. A journalist said Elon Musk should be worried about jail. We play all three clips back to back. [Three different women, one message: get on the other side and you’ll pay for it.](https://us.list-manage.com/7Y9KJ4QEjlA?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)

Then Greg Cunningham came to the studio. His race for CD2 is tied, and he told us why he thinks it decides who runs Congress.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/1LN86X8uYPh?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| |
**🚨 ELISSA SLOTKIN WANTS GRADUATES AFRAID TO WORK FOR TRUMP. SHE SAID SO ON TAPE.**
At the University of Chicago, Senator Slotkin said she wants prosecutions aimed at the people around Trump, so that young people think twice before taking a government job. She called it a “deterrence message.”
Jennifer Welch and Kara Swisher went after JD Vance and Elon Musk the same week. We explain why these three clips are the same playbook, and what it’s meant to do to the people on the other side.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/nvuvgFkvYfo?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
**🇺🇸 GREG CUNNINGHAM IN STUDIO: “I’M NOT INTERESTED IN A SUICIDE MISSION”**
Cunningham is a retired Albuquerque police detective and a Marine. He told us why he got into the race, how he plans to take New Mexico’s worst repeat offenders to federal court, and what he’d say to a voter who isn’t a fan of Trump.
He also told us about the phone call he took the day Charlie Kirk was taken from us, and what his wife said that night. You need to hear this part.

**🗳️ THE EARLY VOTE IS IN, AND REPUBLICANS NEED TO SEE IT**
We pulled the numbers from the Secretary of State. More than 238,000 New Mexicans have voted, and the gap between the parties is wider than it should be with nine days left.
We also take on the idea that real Republicans wait until Election Day. Voting early gets you off the mailer list and saves your candidate money for the voters who are still deciding.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/1ne2eUeo8Jr?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
**PLUS:** The Senate map tightened in five states, and there’s a reason Republicans could still hold it. Abdul El-Sayed lost his cool with Bret Baier on Fox. Martin Heinrich got a full-page Journal ad from his own base, and for once we’re on his side. And the Halloween attack ad on Gregg Hull sounds like a Spirit store commercial.

**Here's the deal, Team:** The Department of Justice (DOJ) is asking a federal court to immediately prevent California from counting the ballots of 20,000 people the Trump administration has accused of being noncitizens who illegally registered to vote. The standoff began when the DOJ sent California a thumb drive _with a hand-scrawled password on a sticky note_ that it claimed contained the names of 20,000 suspected noncitizens registered to vote in the state. The Justice Department gave California only 48 hours to validate those names and demanded that California not count the ballots of anyone on the list. State officials declined, calling the request “ _outrageous_.” **DOJ then immediately responded by filing a lawsuit accusing California election officials of knowingly aiding noncitizens who want to illegally vote in the upcoming election.** The DOJ argued that the 48-hour ultimatum was a “ _modest request_ ," but at the same time, admitted that the enormity of the investigation was too much for even the federal government to prosecute each case. **These baseless attacks are the first concrete steps towards lawfare in the wake of the midterm elections.** Opponents of voting rights read the same polls that we see, and they'd rather invalidate the ballots of those who vote against them than accept losing an election. **California is only their first test case** , and if successful, they will try this in every other state they need to. **[Team, every voter needs to know about this massive issue and be ready to respond in their state. name: Swing Left
subject: Over 200 people came to listen
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Swing Left, [swingleft
body:
Knocking on doors with Ground Truth is one of the best ways to make an impact in the final week before Election Day.
#
Hi there,
Michigan’s Senate race is one of the most competitive in the country, and the outcome here could decide which party controls the Senate for the next two years.
**That’s why this past weekend, we launched a Ground Truth canvass with the Black Voters Matter Coalition and Swing Left Detroit to support Abdul El-Sayed’s campaign—and the turnout was incredible.**
More than **200 volunteers** from Black, Jewish, Muslim, LGBTQ+, and Labor communities showed up at this canvass, alongside actors **Kerry Washington** and **Adam Brody** to knock on doors for Abdul El-Sayed and have deep-listening conversations that can net votes for Democrats this November.
Those volunteers included:
* A three-generation family: a mother, grandmother, and two granddaughters, 11 and 22, who said this election was so important they needed to bring the entire family tree out to listen to voters.
* A history teacher who had a 40-minute conversation with a voter, in spite of later describing himself as more introverted.
* A born-and-raised Detroiter and first-time canvasser who happened to be assigned doors on the street her grandfather once lived on.

[](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=immediate-impact-2026.DM5m6O&utm_source=ak&%3Butm_medium=em&%3Butm_campaign=iif-2026&%3Butm_content=20261026-2&%3Brefcode=ak_em_iif-2026_20261026-2&t=1&akid=3302%2E1562180%2EgIIKKj)
It’s volunteers like you who make Ground Truth possible. And it’s those same volunteers who are carving the path for Democratic candidates in swing races, like Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan, to win across the country.
**Yasmin Radjy** , Executive Director of Swing Left, said, “The energy in Detroit was electric. We brought together 200 people from an incredibly diverse coalition all on ‘Team Win’, united by a commitment that a Democratic Senate majority is essential to making progress on the issues we all care about. For too long, many campaigns across the country have treated voters, particularly Black voters, transactionally and taken them for granted without taking the time to listen. When we knock on doors, people are genuinely surprised that someone wants to hear about what matters most to them. These conversations last 10, 15, even 20 minutes because people are hungry to be heard and hungry for change. We're meeting voters where they are and rebuilding trust brick by brick.”
**Knocking on doors with Ground Truth is one of the best ways to make an impact in the final week before Election Day, and we’re not slowing down until the polls have closed.**
Ground Truth canvasses are going to continue happening in swing districts and states, and we’ve got our final Weekend of Action coming up this Saturday and Sunday!
But it takes a lot of resources to run a program like Ground Truth, and we’re counting on the support of the entire Swing Left community—whether you can volunteer, donate, or spread the word on our work in your community—to get through this last stretch.
[**If you’d like to support Ground Truth in the final days before the Election, make a donation today.** ](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=immediate-impact-2026.DM5m6O&utm_source=ak&%3Butm_medium=em&%3Butm_campaign=iif-2026&%3Butm_content=20261026-2&%3Brefcode=ak_em_iif-2026_20261026-2&t=2&akid=3302%2E1562180%2EgIIKKj)
**[Donate $25 »](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=immediate-impact-2026.DM5m6O&amount=25&utm_source=ak&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=iif-2026&utm_content=20261026-2&refcode=ak_em_iif-2026_20261026-2&t=22&akid=3302%2E1562180%2EgIIKKj)**
Your contribution will support the work to continue turning out voters in the most competitive districts and states across the country.
Thank you, as always, for everything you do,
The Swing Left Team

_P.S. — Want to go even further?[**Click here to use our Take Action Tool**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/3224?t=23&akid=3302%2E1562180%2EgIIKKj) and find the best volunteer opportunity for you in this final week!_

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. [**If you’d like to help support our work, you can make a donation using this link.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_sl_footer?refcode=em20261026-2&t=24&refcode2=3302_1562180_gIIKKj&akid=3302%2E1562180%2EgIIKKj)

And headlines like this one are a flashing red light: According to Politico, “Republicans are on track to outspend Democrats on television about 6-to-1 in Florida.” The GOP is pouring a deluge of money into the state to prop up Donald Trump’s pal Byron Donalds — the vast majority is going into misleading and false attacks on Democracy Defender David Jolly. That’s all you need to know about how important this race for governor is. Florida Republicans see our movement as a threat to Ron DeSantis’s anti-democracy legacy. __The Senate majority is not safe.__

[STAND WITH MAGA](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.com/click/e2103576/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS90cnVtcC1uYXRpb25hbC1jb21taXR0ZWUtamZjL2xwLXByc3AtZW1haWwtcG9lLXYxLXNiLw/SZW1haWxfZnJlZXRoaW5rZXJkYWlseV9jb20yNjEwMjc/LbmNsZEFEdUxuRA/qP3V0bV9tZWRpdW09YnImdXRtX3Rlcm09MjM3NzdfZnRkMQ/gat_sNg/sei01b46041)
Night has settled on the midterms, and it is not a gentle night.
The lamps in the Oval Office burn low. Outside, something keeps tapping at the glass, patient as a verdict. **We may hold the Senate. We may not.** I will not lie to you and call the dark a dawn.
I have walked the halls in the White House when the majority felt solid underfoot. __It does not feel solid now.__ ____
One seat slips, then another, and the gavel changes hands like a throat being cut in silence. The other side does not need a landslide. They need the dark to do their work for them. **_A tired voter. An empty chair. A man who tells himself the night will pass if he stays indoors._**

[DON’T BE THAT PERSON](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.com/click/e2103576/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS90cnVtcC1uYXRpb25hbC1jb21taXR0ZWUtamZjL2xwLXByc3AtZW1haWwtcG9lLXYxLXNiLw/SZW1haWxfZnJlZXRoaW5rZXJkYWlseV9jb20yNjEwMjc/LbmNsZEFEdUxuRA/qP3V0bV9tZWRpdW09YnImdXRtX3Rlcm09MjM3NzdfZnRkMQ/gat_sNg/sei01b46041)

There is a blackness that comes for republics the way it comes for houses. It does not kick down the door. It waits until the people inside decide the fight is already lost. I have felt that blackness at my own shoulder. It knows my name. It would like to know yours, and then forget it.
**_[So stand with me and the MAGA movement while the outcome is still unwritten. Do not leave this fight to the people who want us gone. Donate, and put that money where it cuts the dark: ads that stay up, voters who get pulled off the couch, the last push to hold the Senate. A gift now keeps our message in front of the people who have not yet decided.> ](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.com/click/e2103576/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS90cnVtcC1uYXRpb25hbC1jb21taXR0ZWUtamZjL2xwLXByc3AtZW1haWwtcG9lLXYxLXNiLw/SZW1haWxfZnJlZXRoaW5rZXJkYWlseV9jb20yNjEwMjc/LbmNsZEFEdUxuRA/qP3V0bV9tZWRpdW09YnImdXRtX3Rlcm09MjM3NzdfZnRkMQ/gat_sNg/sei01b46041)_**
If we hold the majority, it will be because you refused to sit in the quiet. If we lose it, let it not be because the movement went still when the night got long.

Police officers detain a protester following a protest call by supporters of jailed former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan's party, Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI), a day after Pakistan imposed a state of emergency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province and suspended the provincial government led by Khan's party, in Peshawar, Pakistan, October 12, 2026. REUTERS
Two days after the imposition of emergency rule in Pakistan's northwestern Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province on October 11, Irfanullah, 27, and his three brothers joined hundreds of protesters in the town of Bara. The rally was one of a series of protests against the imposition of emergency rule and the removal of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa's elected government, which was led by Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf, or PTI, the party of former Prime Minister Imran Khan.
More than a dozen people were injured and at least one person, a 13-year-old boy, was killed after police fired on the protesters October 13, according to witnesses interviewed by Drop Site, images, videos, and hospital records. Four police officers were injured and 50 people were arrested, [according to Dawn](https://substack.com/redirect/483ec6e4-6002-415f-b5b0-6aee629c5021?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The political confrontation has brought protests, arrests of party leaders and workers, and communications disruptions across the province.
"It was a peaceful protest," said Irfanullah, whose younger brother, Munir, 19, was shot in the left foot, according to hospital records obtained by Drop Site News. "The Khyber police fired at the protesters, and as a result, my brother and many others were injured." Irfanullah, who like his brothers is a PTI party worker, remained at Munir's bedside while he was in the hospital. "We didn't cause any unrest nor did we have any intention of starting chaos," Irfanullah said. "We are not planning to abandon PTI. ... We are just demanding and raising our voice for our rights and for peace here, nothing else," he added.
Habeel Khan, the 13-year-old boy who was killed, worked at an eatery in the bazaar, and was caught in the gunfire. His uncle told Drop Site that Habeel was taken to a hospital where he was unable to receive treatment before he was admitted to another hospital in Peshawar, where doctors operated on him. Habeel died in the hospital four days after the protest. According to the hospital death summary, Habeel was shot in the abdomen, sustaining severe injuries to his intestines and an exit wound in his lower back. His recorded causes of death included the gunshot wound, cardiac arrest, and septic shock.
"As a child, he worked to earn money only because of his poverty, otherwise at his age he should've been in school," his uncle said.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f8b34520-7fd9-475c-9676-f4758191cd90?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
An undated family photo of Habeel Khan, who was killed by police gunfire in Bara. Photo used by permission.
Another young boy, whom Drop Site was unable to contact, was selling bread in the bazaar when he was shot by police. In a video obtained by Drop Site, an adolescent boy can be seen lying on a hospital stretcher with a gushing, gunshot wound to his thigh. He says he was shot by local police, adding, "They are terrorists, they are oppressors."
Many locals interviewed by Drop Site said injured protesters were unable to seek treatment at local health care facilities in Bara for fear of arrest, or were turned away because health care providers feared police raids. According to Irfanullah, Munir initially stayed home. On the two occasions he sought treatment at a local hospital, staff turned him away because they feared police would come to arrest him. He later received treatment for his gunshot wound at a hospital in Peshawar.
Maheen Pracha, the spokesperson for the Human Rights Commission of Pakistan, an independent watchdog, said it has received reports of police raids in Peshawar, Swat and Khyber, the dispersal of smaller gatherings, as well as curfews and military deployments.
"Whether it's the PTI in power now or somebody else, the same laws being made now will come back to haunt the next government in power," Pracha said.
Drop Site sent a list of questions to Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Police but did not receive a response before publication. The Embassy of Pakistan did not respond to a request for comment.
According to two "first information reports," or FIRs, filed during the multiday protests, police allege that protesters attacked and injured police officers, held some officers hostage, and destroyed government property. One of the police documents, filed on October 12, calls for the arrest of local PTI leaders and approximately 85 unnamed individuals, describing alleged participants as "agitated and extremist workers of PTI" who were armed with "slingshots, wooden sticks, stones and firearms" and "attacked the police and fired upon them with the firearms and the intention to kill."
A second FIR, filed on October 13, names PTI leaders and other local residents and alleges that a "mob" of approximately 300 PTI workers chanted provocative anti-state slogans and speeches, incited arson, set up roadblocks targeting government property, held police personnel hostage, and subjected them to violence. The FIR states that police responded with a baton charge and aerial firing to disperse the crowd.
PTI chairman Gohar Ali Khan and his legal team are challenging the move in the Peshawar High Court, arguing that the imposition of emergency rule and the removal of the provincial government violate constitutional requirements.
## Federal Takeover
The violence in Bara unfolded amid a broader confrontation between the federal government and PTI, which had governed Khyber Pakhtunkhwa for the last 13 years. The arrest of former Prime Minister Imran Khan in May 2023 sparked protests that escalated into attacks on government buildings and military installations, with thousands of people taken into custody. Khan has been imprisoned since August 2023 and subjected to periods of solitary confinement, following a series of cases brought against him after his ouster from power in April 2022. In recent months, [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/0617f761-2ee3-4efd-8c52-f0aafa878f0d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of Khan's deteriorating health prompted leaders in his party, his family, supporters, and human rights organizations to call for improved prison conditions and access to medical care.
The party had been negotiating Khan's access to health care and his release from prison with the federal government, but the talks stalled. On October 4, thousands of PTI supporters began marching from Khyber Pakhtunkhwa toward Islamabad to press those demands.
In response, Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif convened an emergency cabinet meeting, and on October 11 President Asif Ali Zardari imposed a state of emergency and governor's rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, suspending its elected government on Sharif's advice and citing a surge in terrorism and political unrest to justify the decisions. The Chief Minister Sohail Afridi, provincial PTI president Junaid Akbar, Assembly Speaker Babar Saleem Swati, and several other party leaders were detained. Pakistan's Army was deployed to the province the same day and will remain there throughout the duration of emergency rule.
"The government is sort of willing to say [Afridi] is in protective custody, but isn't willing to produce him before a court, or give any evidence of where he is. This is the chief executive of a province of 45 million people," said a senior PTI leader, who was in hiding and spoke to Drop Site on condition of anonymity for security reasons.
Six days after assuming governor's rule, Governor Faisal Karim Kundi said the province would extract and sell its mineral resources, and specifically referred to mineral resources in districts including Lakki Marwat, Tank, and Bannu. He also called for joint ventures with domestic and foreign companies to develop its oil and gas reserves. The province is rich in natural resources, including natural gas, copper, chromite, lead, emeralds, marble, limestone, and coal, and produces up to 50% of Pakistan's total daily domestic crude oil production.
## Constitutional Challenge
PTI leaders and constitutional experts are challenging the legality of the federal government's imposition of emergency rule. Asad Jamal, a Lahore-based lawyer and constitutional law expert, said Zardari's proclamation failed to meet the constitutional standards required to justify the measures. Citing terrorist incidents alone, he said, was not sufficient.
"I'm not a supporter of PTI," Jamal said. "So it makes me reiterate that the constitutional provisions are being used in a very dishonest manner against one province, which violates the autonomy of a province. It is discriminatory in essence."
Under Article 232 of the constitution, emergency rule can be imposed in response to a grave emergency involving internal disturbances beyond a provincial government's power to control. Under governor's rule, permitted under Article 234, the president can transfer the provincial government's executive powers to the governor and allow Parliament to exercise the provincial assembly's powers.
"The proclamation does not reach that threshold," Jamal said. "They are alleging that the provincial government does not have the political will to fight terrorism. How do you empirically and objectively measure a government's political will in order to exercise these powers?"
On October 15, Pakistan's parliament approved the governor's rule for an initial two-month period. Any continuation requires further parliamentary approval, and the measure cannot remain in force for more than six months in total.
Regarding the removal of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa's government, Jamal said that there is "no provision in the constitution" that says "the provincial government is disbanded" during a state of emergency.
According to the constitution, Jamal said, the provincial government should only lose certain powers, but the chief minister and the elected government remain. "The chief minister was picked up ... under which constitutional or legal provision has he been arrested?"
Jamal added that there's no concept of a governing secretariat in the constitution or in any federal or provincial law.
"Where has this come from?" he asked. "The proclamation has come at a particular political moment when the provincial government was leading a protest march, which would enter the capital," Jamal said, "That is what the federal government was afraid of."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/29b2b6e7-02eb-4c55-a44a-655559bdb6cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaaf (PTI) party's chairman Gohar Ali Khan (C) speaks to media outside the Adiala prison in Rawalpindi on January 17, 2025. Photo by FAROOQ NAEEM/AFP via Getty Images.
On October 14, PTI's legal team filed a petition in the Peshawar High Court on behalf of party chairman Gohar Ali Khan challenging the constitutionality of the emergency and governor's rule.
"They can declare it unconstitutional, roll back everything done in the past 15 days or so," Jamal said.
Sameer Khosa is representing Gohar in the case. He told Drop Site that PTI wants the government to disclose the evidence it relied on to justify the proclamation, including the governor's report.
"One of the things that we are asking for in court is that the material relied upon by the president to issue the proclamation has to be brought before the court so that it can be reviewed as to what is the evidence on the basis of which the proclamation has been issued," Khosa told Drop Site.
## High Stakes for Democracy
The consequences of the federal takeover extend beyond Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, raising broader concerns about human rights, civilian authority, and democracy across Pakistan.
The state of emergency and governor's rule is a significant escalation in Pakistan's longstanding struggle between civilian authority and the military, according to Aqil Shah, a political scientist at Georgetown University and author of "The Army and Democracy: Military Politics in Pakistan _._ "
"It's an important setback because the PTI has been ... disempowered and dismantled, pretty much at all levels," Shah said.
The move has not only stripped the PTI from power but has deprived the people of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa of political representation, leaving them ruled by a governor and technocrats who effectively act as military proxies, Shah said, adding that the military's political ambitions extend beyond Munir's personal grievances, including Khan's removal of Munir as Inter-Services Intelligence chief. The military's broader objective, he said, is to prevent civilian leaders from challenging its dominance over national security, internal security, and electoral politics.
Shah described Khan as "an existential threat" to the military's rule.
"The only political challenge is Imran Khan and the sort of adjunct challenge of the PTI government KP, and so those have been contained," he added.
The senior PTI leader told Drop Site the party would likely participate in the next elections, but Shah said the vote was unlikely to be free and fair.
The current federal coalition of the Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz, or PML-N, and the Pakistan Peoples Party, or PPP, came to power after an election [marred](https://substack.com/redirect/e50c5133-e643-466b-b29f-78b0d4e76405?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by [allegations of rigging](https://substack.com/redirect/462dd680-d101-46c2-b52e-172faf1ea4a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Pakistan's election commission has denied the allegations, but a senior official [admitted](https://substack.com/redirect/1179d3db-1764-4573-955c-83bd4f60cfb9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to participating in efforts to manipulate the results.
The military has little incentive to rule directly, Shah said, because it can exercise power through civilian political allies without assuming direct responsibility for the country's governance. The country's most popular leader is imprisoned, while other parties are willing to cooperate with the military, allowing it to retain de facto power without accepting responsibility for governing.
Pakistan's 27th Constitutional Amendment, passed last year, granted lifelong immunity to the president and the army chief, a provision that currently applies to Field Marshal and Army Chief Asim Munir and other top officers. Shah said this measure reflects the military's broader interest in shielding itself from civilian accountability.
"Accountability is always reserved for civilians, and it's punitive and vindictive accountability," Shah said. "[Munir] wants to be immune from any sort of accountability for life till he dies. It's not about being in uniform. It's forever."
_Ali Akhtar Afridi contributed reporting in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa._

Please consider making a. | | ---|---|--- Police officers detain a protester following a protest call by supporters of jailed former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan's party, Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI), a day after Pakistan imposed a state of emergency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province and suspended the provincial government led by Khan's party, in Peshawar, Pakistan, October 12, 2026. REUTERS Two days after the imposition of emergency rule in Pakistan's northwestern Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province on October 11, Irfanullah, 27, and his three brothers joined hundreds of protesters in the town of Bara. The rally was one of a series of protests against the imposition of emergency rule and the removal of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa's elected government, which was led by Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf, or PTI, the party of former Prime Minister Imran Khan. More than a dozen people were injured and at least one person, a 13-year-old boy, was killed after police fired on the protesters October 13, according to witnesses interviewed by Drop Site, images, videos, and hospital records. Four police officers were injured and 50 people were arrested, . The political confrontation has brought protests, arrests of party leaders and workers, and communications disruptions across the province. "It was a peaceful protest," said Irfanullah, whose younger brother, Munir, 19, was shot in the left foot, according to hospital records obtained by Drop Site News. "The Khyber police fired at the protesters, and as a result, my brother and many others were injured." Irfanullah, who like his brothers is a PTI party worker, remained at Munir's bedside while he was in the hospital. "We didn't cause any unrest nor did we have any intention of starting chaos," Irfanullah said. "We are not planning to abandon PTI. ... We are just demanding and raising our voice for our rights and for peace here, nothing else," he added. Habeel Khan, the 13-year-old boy who was killed, worked at an eatery in the bazaar, and was caught in the gunfire. His uncle told Drop Site that Habeel was taken to a hospital where he was unable to receive treatment before he was admitted to another hospital in Peshawar, where doctors operated on him. Habeel died in the hospital four days after the protest. According to the hospital death summary, Habeel was shot in the abdomen, sustaining severe injuries to his intestines and an exit wound in his lower back. His recorded causes of death included the gunshot wound, cardiac arrest, and septic shock. "As a child, he worked to earn money only because of his poverty, otherwise at his age he should've been in school," his uncle said. | | ---|---|--- An undated family photo of Habeel Khan, who was killed by police gunfire in Bara. Photo used by permission. Another young boy, whom Drop Site was unable to contact, was selling bread in the bazaar when he was shot by police. In a video obtained by Drop Site, an adolescent boy can be seen lying on a hospital stretcher with a gushing, gunshot wound to his thigh. He says he was shot by local police, adding, "They are terrorists, they are oppressors." Many locals interviewed by Drop Site said injured protesters were unable to seek treatment at local health care facilities in Bara for fear of arrest, or were turned away because health care providers feared police raids. According to Irfanullah, Munir initially stayed home. On the two occasions he sought treatment at a local hospital, staff turned him away because they feared police would come to arrest him. He later received treatment for his gunshot wound at a hospital in Peshawar. Maheen Pracha, the spokesperson for the Human Rights Commission of Pakistan, an independent watchdog, said it has received reports of police raids in Peshawar, Swat and Khyber, the dispersal of smaller gatherings, as well as curfews and military deployments. "Whether it's the PTI in power now or somebody else, the same laws being made now will come back to haunt the next government in power," Pracha said. Drop Site sent a list of questions to Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Police but did not receive a response before publication. The Embassy of Pakistan did not respond to a request for comment. According to two "first information reports," or FIRs, filed during the multiday protests, police allege that protesters attacked and injured police officers, held some officers hostage, and destroyed government property. One of the police documents, filed on October 12, calls for the arrest of local PTI leaders and approximately 85 unnamed individuals, describing alleged participants as "agitated and extremist workers of PTI" who were armed with "slingshots, wooden sticks, stones and firearms" and "attacked the police and fired upon them with the firearms and the intention to kill." A second FIR, filed on October 13, names PTI leaders and other local residents and alleges that a "mob" of approximately 300 PTI workers chanted provocative anti-state slogans and speeches, incited arson, set up roadblocks targeting government property, held police personnel hostage, and subjected them to violence. The FIR states that police responded with a baton charge and aerial firing to disperse the crowd. PTI chairman Gohar Ali Khan and his legal team are challenging the move in the Peshawar High Court, arguing that the imposition of emergency rule and the removal of the provincial government violate constitutional requirements. Federal Takeover The violence in Bara unfolded amid a broader confrontation between the federal government and PTI, which had governed Khyber Pakhtunkhwa for the last 13 years. The arrest of former Prime Minister Imran Khan in May 2023 sparked protests that escalated into attacks on government buildings and military installations, with thousands of people taken into custody. Khan has been imprisoned since August 2023 and subjected to periods of solitary confinement, following a series of cases brought against him after his ouster from power in April 2022. In recent months, of Khan's deteriorating health prompted leaders in his party, his family, supporters, and human rights organizations to call for improved prison conditions and access to medical care. The party had been negotiating Khan's access to health care and his release from prison with the federal government, but the talks stalled. On October 4, thousands of PTI supporters began marching from Khyber Pakhtunkhwa toward Islamabad to press those demands. In response, Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif convened an emergency cabinet meeting, and on October 11 President Asif Ali Zardari imposed a state of emergency and governor's rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, suspending its elected government on Sharif's advice and citing a surge in terrorism and political unrest to justify the decisions. The Chief Minister Sohail Afridi, provincial PTI president Junaid Akbar, Assembly Speaker Babar Saleem Swati, and several other party leaders were detained. Pakistan's Army was deployed to the province the same day and will remain there throughout the duration of emergency rule. "The government is sort of willing to say [Afridi] is in protective custody, but isn't willing to produce him before a court, or give any evidence of where he is. This is the chief executive of a province of 45 million people," said a senior PTI leader, who was in hiding and spoke to Drop Site on condition of anonymity for security reasons. Six days after assuming governor's rule, Governor Faisal Karim Kundi said the province would extract and sell its mineral resources, and specifically referred to mineral resources in districts including Lakki Marwat, Tank, and Bannu. He also called for joint ventures with domestic and foreign companies to develop its oil and gas reserves. The province is rich in natural resources, including natural gas, copper, chromite, lead, emeralds, marble, limestone, and coal, and produces up to 50% of Pakistan's total daily domestic crude oil production. Constitutional Challenge PTI leaders and constitutional experts are challenging the legality of the federal government's imposition of emergency rule. Asad Jamal, a Lahore-based lawyer and constitutional law expert, said Zardari's proclamation failed to meet the constitutional standards required to justify the measures. Citing terrorist incidents alone, he said, was not sufficient. "I'm not a supporter of PTI," Jamal said. "So it makes me reiterate that the constitutional provisions are being used in a very dishonest manner against one province, which violates the autonomy of a province. It is discriminatory in essence." Under Article 232 of the constitution, emergency rule can be imposed in response to a grave emergency involving internal disturbances beyond a provincial government's power to control. Under governor's rule, permitted under Article 234, the president can transfer the provincial government's executive powers to the governor and allow Parliament to exercise the provincial assembly's powers. "The proclamation does not reach that threshold," Jamal said. "They are alleging that the provincial government does not have the political will to fight terrorism. How do you empirically and objectively measure a government's political will in order to exercise these powers?" On October 15, Pakistan's parliament approved the governor's rule for an initial two-month period. Any continuation requires further parliamentary approval, and the measure cannot remain in force for more than six months in total. Regarding the removal of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa's government, Jamal said that there is "no provision in the constitution" that says "the provincial government is disbanded" during a state of emergency. According to the constitution, Jamal said, the provincial government should only lose certain powers, but the chief minister and the elected government remain. "The chief minister was picked up ... under which constitutional or legal provision has he been arrested?" Jamal added that there's no concept of a governing secretariat in the constitution or in any federal or provincial law. "Where has this come from?" he asked. "The proclamation has come at a particular political moment when the provincial government was leading a protest march, which would enter the capital," Jamal said, "That is what the federal government was afraid of." | | ---|---|--- Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaaf (PTI) party's chairman Gohar Ali Khan (C) speaks to media outside the Adiala prison in Rawalpindi on January 17, 2025. Photo by FAROOQ NAEEM/AFP via Getty Images. On October 14, PTI's legal team filed a petition in the Peshawar High Court on behalf of party chairman Gohar Ali Khan challenging the constitutionality of the emergency and governor's rule. "They can declare it unconstitutional, roll back everything done in the past 15 days or so," Jamal said. Sameer Khosa is representing Gohar in the case. He told Drop Site that PTI wants the government to disclose the evidence it relied on to justify the proclamation, including the governor's report. "One of the things that we are asking for in court is that the material relied upon by the president to issue the proclamation has to be brought before the court so that it can be reviewed as to what is the evidence on the basis of which the proclamation has been issued," Khosa told Drop Site. High Stakes for Democracy The consequences of the federal takeover extend beyond Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, raising broader concerns about human rights, civilian authority, and democracy across Pakistan. The state of emergency and governor's rule is a significant escalation in Pakistan's longstanding struggle between civilian authority and the military, according to Aqil Shah, a political scientist at Georgetown University and author of "The Army and Democracy: Military Politics in Pakistan . " "It's an important setback because the PTI has been ... disempowered and dismantled, pretty much at all levels," Shah said. The move has not only stripped the PTI from power but has deprived the people of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa of political representation, leaving them ruled by a governor and technocrats who effectively act as military proxies, Shah said, adding that the military's political ambitions extend beyond Munir's personal grievances, including Khan's removal of Munir as Inter-Services Intelligence chief. The military's broader objective, he said, is to prevent civilian leaders from challenging its dominance over national security, internal security, and electoral politics. Shah described Khan as "an existential threat" to the military's rule. "The only political challenge is Imran Khan and the sort of adjunct challenge of the PTI government KP, and so those have been contained," he added. The senior PTI leader told Drop Site the party would likely participate in the next elections, but Shah said the vote was unlikely to be free and fair. The current federal coalition of the Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz, or PML-N, and the Pakistan Peoples Party, or PPP, came to power after an election by . Pakistan's election commission has denied the allegations, but a senior official to participating in efforts to manipulate the results. The military has little incentive to rule directly, Shah said, because it can exercise power through civilian political allies without assuming direct responsibility for the country's governance. The country's most popular leader is imprisoned, while other parties are willing to cooperate with the military, allowing it to retain de facto power without accepting responsibility for governing. Pakistan's 27th Constitutional Amendment, passed last year, granted lifelong immunity to the president and the army chief, a provision that currently applies to Field Marshal and Army Chief Asim Munir and other top officers. Shah said this measure reflects the military's broader interest in shielding itself from civilian accountability. "Accountability is always reserved for civilians, and it's punitive and vindictive accountability," Shah said. "[Munir] wants to be immune from any sort of accountability for life till he dies. It's not about being in uniform. It's forever." Ali Akhtar Afridi contributed reporting in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. | A guest post by| Journalist based in Washington, D.C. name: Team Scott
subject: Know Before You Vote: Nationally-focused Experiments vs. Real Plans for Vermont
body:
| | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/philscott/know-before-you-vote-nationally-focused-experiments-vs-real-plans-for-vermont?e=19cebfe173)

| | |
#

# **Know Before You Vote **
**Two Different Paths for Vermont’s Future ** **Nationally-focused Experiments vs. Real Plans for Vermont** For several decades, Vermont’s affordability crisis has been driven by costly policies and rising taxes tied to a national party agenda. The Governor’s opponent, Amanda Janoo, has made it clear that she will double down on the kinds of policy experiments that have contributed to Vermont’s crisis of affordability. Governor Phil Scott, meanwhile, has led the fight to reform Vermont’s education, healthcare, housing, energy, and public safety systems – to make them more affordable and more effective. These different approaches give Vermonters a very clear choice in this election. **30+ YEARS OF EXPERIMENTS ** Here are just a few examples:
* **Education Property Taxes (aka Act 60):** Designed 30 years ago, this “blank check” funding formula fueled decades of skyrocketing property tax increases, including the roughly 40% increase in property taxes in the last 5 years. Promised improvements in equity and outcomes never materialized – and have in fact gotten worse. For 8 years, the majority rejected Governor Scott’s plans to fix this system. Under intense political pressure to take action in 2024, they finally yielded in the last legislative session.
* **“Single Payer” Healthcare:** Abandoned by Democratic leaders in 2014 after millions of dollars spent to discover an unaffordable and economically harmful multi billion-dollar price tag.
* **The “Clean Heat Standard”:** Forced through by the supermajority, despite potentially adding $0.70/gallon the price of home heating fuel. The majority opted not to move forward with it in 2025, but the laws enabling it remain on the books.
* **The “Renewable Energy Standard”: **Forced through by the supermajority, despite expected electricity cost increases of up to $250 million in the next 10-years alone, with no measurable improvement in carbon emissions.
* **New Land Use Restrictions (aka Act 181):** Forced through by the supermajority, despite clear harm to rural Vermont. Partially repealed in 2026 after rural Vermont spoke up and there was more balance in the Legislature. Harmful and counterproductive provisions of Act 181 remain.

**And they’re on top of an unnecessary $100 million payroll tax, a 20% hike in DMV fees, and other unhelpful “first in the nation” taxpayer-funded experiments that have failed. ** **And Vermonters are footing the bill.** **JANOO WILL DOUBLE DOWN & USE VERMONT TO ‘TRANSFORM THE GLOBAL ECONOMIC SYSTEM’** Amanda Janoo has been very clear she will use Vermont’s state government (and its population of just 640,000 people) to lead a transformation of the global economic system. “‘I feel like my purpose in life, or what I hope to achieve, **is to transform the global economic system,** ’ Janoo said in a Vermont Public interview last year, when discussing why she was thinking about running for governor. Vermont Public continued: “These twin goals — governing Vermont and remaking the global economic order — are symbiotic for Janoo. ... She’s convinced that **Vermont-based experiments** in housing, healthcare and education can create models for the rest of the world to replicate.” Vermonters cannot afford any more experiments-gone-wrong at taxpayers' expense. **If Amanda Janoo wants to “transform the global economic system,” she should be running for Congress – not Governor. ** **GOVERNOR SCOTT’S REAL PLANS FOR REAL RESULTS ** In contrast, Governor Scott has proposed - and is already implementing - **_real plans_ **for:
* **[Healthcare](https://us.list-manage.com/dE5r49tkzky?e=19cebfe173&c2id=84d1094b3a168b6495ef78aca9f3540c) – **Expanding affordable options and addressing the costs of coverage.** **
* **[Housing](https://us.list-manage.com/1h0WxKCvDfV?e=19cebfe173&c2id=84d1094b3a168b6495ef78aca9f3540c) – **Accelerating construction and rehabilitation, and reducing regulatory and permitting barriers.
* **[Education](https://us.list-manage.com/ti5cw26Jhiy?e=19cebfe173&c2id=84d1094b3a168b6495ef78aca9f3540c) **– Transforming governance and funding to address costs, expand opportunities, improve outcomes, and pay teachers in rural areas more fairly. ** **
* **[Public Safety](https://us.list-manage.com/10VTQk079fD?e=19cebfe173&c2id=84d1094b3a168b6495ef78aca9f3540c) **– Restoring accountability for repeat offenders, reducing violence, and improving treatment.
* **[Energy Costs](https://us.list-manage.com/5lA6KUCv6bo?e=19cebfe173&c2id=84d1094b3a168b6495ef78aca9f3540c) **– Removing policies that add about $2.5 million each year to electric bills, while also lowering climate emissions.

Governor Scott’s plans are focused on fixing systems to get real results. With more support in the Legislature, he can get these things done. **The choice in this election is clear. ** Real plans that Vermonters can afford from Governor Scott. Or, doubling down on the costly experiments that got us here in the first place. **###**

body:
Trump’s not going to give up this seat without a fight. Neither will I.

Peter, I just want to say – thank you, thank you, thank you.
You haven’t chipped in to my U.S. Senate campaign yet, but I appreciate that you’d take the time just to read my email.
Experts maintain that North Carolina is our best chance to flip a Senate seat blue this cycle, and momentum is on our side. In a state that hasn’t gone blue for a federal election since 2008, this wouldn’t be possible without grassroots supporters like you.
Now, the GOP is clearly panicking – but it’s not all good news:
* Both President Trump and Vice President Vance held rallies in North Carolina last week to put their thumbs on the scale for my MAGA opponent Michael Whatley.
* A super PAC with direct ties to Trump announced it’s launching new million-dollar ads attacking me for this final eight-day stretch.
* Donald Trump promised he’d join my MAGA opponent on the trail in NC one more time.
**Trump is undefeated in North Carolina, but so am I.** He’s not going to give up this seat without a fight, so we can’t let the positive polls and predictions lull us into complacency.
With only eight days left to take on the MAGA machine and win, I need your help to continue building the biggest voter mobilization effort in state history. [**_So if you understand the stakes, I’m asking you to make your first donation to my grassroots campaign today – $5 or any amount will do. Will you please chip in to help me win in North Carolina and flip the Senate blue?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1759&amount=5&t=8&akid=4981%2E124072%2EahmhSE)

clean_body: Peter, My name is Emily, and I'm a ballot chaser for Turning Point PAC in Arizona. That means every day, I show up, knock on doors, have conversations with potential voters, and chase down ballots before Election Day. I need to tell you what I'm seeing out here, because I don't think most people understand how close this really is. Arizona is not lost.Not even close. But it is not safe either. A new poll just showed Katie Hobbs up by 4 points over Andy Biggs. Four points. That is the entire ballgame, sitting right there behind the doors I have not knocked on yet. - Turning Point PAC is not like anything else in this space. They take decades of grassroots organizing and put real people, like me, into these communities well before Election Day. We build relationships. We knock on the same doors more than once. We chase every ballot, mail-in or in person, because every single one counts. This is the vision Charlie Kirk built. People on the ground, having real conversations, changing real minds. And it is working! But I cannot do this alone, and neither can the 700 of us out here across Arizona. I 'm seeing momentum on the ground, but we have so many more voters to cover. We can't do it without your continued support. Every $50 you give sponsors a ballot chaser like me for one full day. That's about 75 doors and 25 real conversations with voters who haven't made up their minds yet, and who deserve to hear from us before it's too late. For America and for Charlie, A Turning Point PAC Arizona Ballot Chaser Paid for by Turning Point PAC Arizona. Not authorized by any candidate or agents acting on any candidate's behalf. Top Donor: William Scroggins.

Right now time is not on our side.
**October 29th is the last day our campaign can add to our television buys.** That's why we set a goal to raise $500,000 to help get our message out, but we're falling behind.
Whatever we've got on the air by Thursday is what New Hampshire will see right up until Election Day. We can't add to it afterward, no matter how the race changes.
Here's why that matters so much in our state. **We don 't have early voting.** In the last midterm, about 90% of Granite Staters cast their ballots on Election Day itself.
The voters who will decide this race are still weighing their choices, and many of them are getting their information from the same place they always have: the TV in their living room.
Our opponent and dark money outside groups are spending three times what we are, and their ads are running constantly. We can keep pace with them, but only if we raise the resources before the deadline.
**[As of today we're still $276,850.87 short of our $500,000 goal with four days left.](https://substack.com/redirect/07f440c1-70f7-469d-8ff9-ed96d32c2d28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/07f440c1-70f7-469d-8ff9-ed96d32c2d28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Between now and Thursday, we have one job: close the gap on our $500,000 goal so we can get our message in front of as many New Hampshire voters as possible before the window closes.
If you've already given, thank you. If you can give again, this is the moment it counts most. If you've never given to this campaign, there won't be a moment when a first contribution matters more than right now.
**[Whatever you can chip in goes directly toward what voters will see in the final stretch of this race, so they hear from us right up to Election Day.](https://substack.com/redirect/07f440c1-70f7-469d-8ff9-ed96d32c2d28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ HELP US REACH $500,000 BEFORE THURSDAY](https://substack.com/redirect/07f440c1-70f7-469d-8ff9-ed96d32c2d28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thank you,
Chris
Before you go!
**John Sununu has taken the lead in the polls thanks to over $65 million in GOP spending -- and we know even more money is hitting the airwaves soon.**
To compete with their millions, we need you.
But with just 8 days left of this campaign, we're running out of time to close this gap and keep New Hampshire blue.
**[Will you chip in $10 or whatever you can afford today to help elect Chris Pappas and flip the Senate?](https://substack.com/redirect/07f440c1-70f7-469d-8ff9-ed96d32c2d28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

body:

Peter,
I’m going to be straight with you, because we don’t have time for anything else: we're about to hit our most important deadline EVER. The LAST one before Election Day.
When the clock hits midnight on October 31, that’s it. No more second chances. And just three days after, Central New York decide who represents them in Congress.
Right now, this race is WITHIN RANGE.
**We know NY-22 is one of the best opportunities in the entire country to FLIP a seat and protect President Trump’s majority. The Democrats know it, too. That’s why they’re throwing everything they have at us.**
With just a little over a week to fight back, I'm going ALL IN.
_So here’s our goal: raise $22,000 by midnight on October 31._

I grew up in Auburn. My dad spent 41 years as a correctional officer. My mom cares for Alzheimer’s patients. I know what hard work looks like, and I know what it looks like when Washington forgets the people who do it.

# Seven Days and a Wake up.
Dear friend, In just seven days, Maryland will be going to the polls on Election Day and deciding whether they will vote for higher taxes, more fees, extreme structural deficits and higher electric bills, or for common sense relief and a stable and prosperous state.

We are now just $18,000 away from our immediate goal for the final cable TV purchase. I have given a matching fund of that amount in order to ensure we cross the finish line strong. But I need your help to match this amount and help me pay for the ads. Thank you to so many who are joining us in this fight.

Remember the Maryland 400. They, the "Old Line," saved General Washington's Army just over a month after the Declaration of Independence was signed, allowing through heroic attack the escape of the entire American Army after being surrounded at the Battle of Long Island.
[](https://us.list-manage.com/SULKj11jmw_?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)
[Click Here to help us buy Cable TV Ads to Fight for Maryland](https://us.list-manage.com/OiIBZYQsUDm?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)

Now in the same spirit of our Maryland 400 - we must stop the disastrous agenda of Absentee Governor Wes Moore. He does not care for you, our children or the future of our State - for him it is all about national appearances and running for president. Consider how he's left Maryland behind:
* highest electric bills in the nation
* second worst economy in the nation
* one of two states with a massive structural deficit
* raised property taxes by valuation increase of 26% last year - more on its way unless we replace him
* $200+ car registration fees
* Key Bridge - not built and not under contract
* Purple Line - doubled in cost to $10 billion and no service yet
* Red Line - a lot of money and not even broken ground
* Triple Crown - excluded from the Thoroughbred Racing
* A-10 Fighter Wing - gone to Michigan Gov. Whitmer
* Commanders - leaving
* Guinness - closed
* Triple A bond rating - gone
* $5 billion Gov Hogan surplus - gone and now we are $3 billion in structural deficit
* 300+ days out of state - nearly a year of his term - running for president

Help me stop him here in Maryland and save our State and nation from his reckless, continued tax and spend policies making us one of the worst economies in the Nation - second worst to be exact.

[Will you chip in to help me reach our Cable TV purchase goal tonight? $176, or in remembrance of our brave Maryland 400, will you donate $400, or even $1776](https://us.list-manage.com/G6UIM8HeT2d?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)?

The election turnout is currently on par or just about 10% under the Hogan 2018 turnout - a great indicator for us as so many independents and swing democrats are fed up like you with the direction of the state! Wes Moore is losing. With your help we will win.

Thank you.

For Maryland,

Dan Cox
Candidate for Governor of Maryland

Authority: Dan Cox for Governor, Nick Krop, CPA, Treasurer.

I’ve treated kids with broken bones, severe asthma, life-threatening infections—and, yes, gunshot wounds. I’ve seen the trauma that gun violence causes, not just to the children who survive, but to their families, their classmates, and their communities. **It’s heartbreaking. And what’s worse is that _it’s preventable._** That’s why it infuriates me to see people like Darline keep doing the gun lobby’s bidding. **\- I’ve literally been at the bedside of children with bullet holes in them, missing parts of their skull and having to learn to walk and speak again.** **\- Meanwhile, Darline says that to her "gun control is how steady you hold your weapon." It's no surprise she champions legislation that keeps us less safe.** We can have safer schools, safer neighborhoods, and laws that put our children’s lives ahead of special interests. body:
I need your help before our final end-of-month deadline.

Peter,
This email isn’t going out to everyone. I’m only sending this to a small group of people: folks who haven’t donated to our campaign yet, but who have stayed engaged with our updates and who might be inclined to chip in for the first time today. **Your name popped up.**
First, I want to say thank you for even opening this message. I know you’re probably getting a lot of emails like this right now, so I appreciate your time and attention.
Here’s the situation: **We’re just one week out from the election – and just days away from our final end-of-month fundraising deadline of this campaign.**
Our ability to reach our ambitious $5 million goal will determine whether we’re carrying momentum into the final days of this race. Whether our opponent, Michael Whatley, and his megadonors should be _scared_. Whether we can actually win this thing.

subject: These emails...
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jon Ossoff for Senate
body:
While I certainly don’t expect you or anyone else to donate to every email my team and I send, I hope you’ll consider donating to this one.
# [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4629?t=1&akid=3189%2E5691347%2EDXXh-4)

Peter,
Let me guess: when you open up your email inbox, you’re bombarded with emails from political campaigns or advocacy organizations, some of which you may not have even heard of.
I know it’s a lot. And it’s why in a sea of promises that “Donald Trump is FINISHED” and breathless “5X MATCH NOW!!!” emails, I work really hard to make sure our messages are different.
And the fact that you even opened this email gives me hope it’s working. Thank you.
Peter, if I could, I would wave a magic wand, overturn _Citizens United_ and get big money out of politics. Then I wouldn’t need to send these emails in order to fight back against the onslaught of right-wing Super PAC money.
But here’s the truth: almost all of the donations we receive come from people giving $10, $25, or $50 at a time — very often responding to emails like this one.
And while I certainly don’t expect you or anyone else to donate to every email my team and I send, I hope you’ll consider donating to this one.

confirm the president’s nominee for another justice to take more of our
rights away.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261027_2.kmP0h0&refcode=em20261027-2&t=1003&akid=9793%2E582294%2EhE0QOO ]Will you give $1, $5, or whatever you can afford right now to help
Chris earn the votes of more people in New Hampshire?

Chris Pappas will vote to lift the weight of worries that the president
keeps adding to and that the Republican Senate majority has enabled.

And the Republican Senate majority has failed to stop the president from
spending OUR tax dollars building vanity projects, destroying buildings
that belong to all of us, and profiting from the power of his office.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261027_2.kmP0h0&refcode=em20261027-2&t=1004&akid=9793%2E582294%2EhE0QOO ]We need Chris in the Senate to say NO to the president’s whiplash
whims.

We don’t know whether Sununu would have voted for the resolution directing
the President to remove U.S. Armed Forces from hostilities with Iran. But
we do know that Chris Pappas has consistently voted YES to bring our
military family members home.

John E. Sununu and his family appear to have a close relationship with
power and money and maybe not as close with everyday people.

Chris Pappas IS everyday people. And that’s why he needs our help to pay
for gas to travel around the state and earn the votes of Granite Staters
wherever they are.

Will you join me in helping Chris reach more voters?
[If your number isn’t in a box, click OTHER and enter your amount.]

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261027_2.kmP0h0&amount=5&refcode=em20261027-2&t=1023&akid=9793%2E582294%2EhE0QOO ]Donate $5 »

Chris is
gaining momentum — but the super-wealthy Republican donors are spending
even more money to turn their wave of negative ads into an October
tsunami.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261027_2.kmP0h0&refcode=em20261027-2&t=1024&akid=9793%2E582294%2EhE0QOO ]Will you help Chris’s campaign build more momentum?

Whether you donate or not, here are two other ways you can support Chris
for free.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/695?t=1025&akid=9793%2E582294%2EhE0QOO ]Vote.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/signup/take_action_pappas_campaign/?source=em20261027-2&t=1026&akid=9793%2E582294%2EhE0QOO ]Volunteer.

I know it’s hard to feel hopeful with so many people
struggling, and it’s even harder if
you’re among them. But hope may lie in the growing movement to replace
corruption and depravity with hope and humanity.

Thank you for participating in whatever ways you can. We can do this.

With my best wishes to you and your family,

- Carole

Carole King is a singer-songwriter, author, and activist. Her
distinctions include a Grammy Lifetime Achievement Award, a Kennedy
Center Honor, and double-induction into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame.
Now Carole is using her platform to help elect candidates who are
running to lift and improve the lives of their fellow Americans. And she
really did write this email.

name: Amy Acton
subject: I know garbage when I see it
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SHAPIRO FOR PENNSYLVANIA]
body:
[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/21157?t=1001&akid=800%2E245147%2EiXtwj2 ]Image of Dr. Amy Acton standing next to a trash bin

Vivek Ramaswamy's attacks on me – they're a bunch of
garbage, Derek.

He's using AI to come after my family, and fact-checkers are calling his
latest ads straight up false.

Frankly, Derek,
it's disturbing how far he will go and how easily he can lie to Ohioans.

But here's what he can't lie about: this is a neck-and-neck race. We're
tied in the polls, and our momentum is growing each and every day.

But even though his ads are repulsive and a bunch of garbage, they're
dominating the airwaves right now.

To be honest, Vivek and his allies are outspending us 7:1 on TV ads.
That's because he's being bankrolled by billionaires who will say and
spend whatever to get their way.

That means we’ll need a strong, grassroots base to stay competitive and
keep our ads on air. Experts are calling this the single most competitive
race in the entire country.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/21157?t=1002&akid=800%2E245147%2EiXtwj2 ]So anything you can split between me and Josh Shapiro in the next 30

body:

A heartfelt message from a veteran fighting for you.
| [](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews._WCJ-btlEQ)
---

Guided by my faith and surrounded by my wife, a high school sweetheart, and our beautiful children, I've experienced firsthand the blessings of America's greatest values.
[My life's mission has been to preserve this American greatness, first by serving in the Air Force and now as a constitutional lawyer fighting anyone who infringes upon our freedom.](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews._B_cImMiUGZ0Q)
Yet, I've seen time and time again how fragile our liberty is and the countless evil minds that seek to either take advantage of America or outright destroy it.
And let me tell you, the Radical Leftists have been especially relentless.
They would do anything for their woke agenda, but they would do absolutely nothing for our nation.
[As a proud seventh-generation Texan, I am beyond fed up.](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.)
I'm fighting because Texas needs a leader who is unapologetically patriotic and is not afraid to say so. There are far too many politicians who are bought or compromised, having long forgotten why they decided to serve in the first place.
[President Trump has seen my commitment to America First, and I am honored to have his 100% endorsement. But the Radical Left is doubling down on its attacks against me because they know America First is their greatest enemy.](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.)
That's why I need your help, Peter.

We're one week out from Election Day, and this is our opponent: **Donald Trump 's hand-picked nominee, John Sununu.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1d51501a-06e1-4cc8-a1c4-7bd477574438?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

He's got the name of a powerful political dynasty, the support of the entire GOP, and a super PAC with an $800 million war chest ready to go. I'm depending on this grassroots team to be able to compete.
**[Polls show us down in this battleground Senate race with just 7 days left of this campaign. Will you chip in $50, $25, $5, or any amount so we can retake the lead before it's too late?](https://substack.com/redirect/1d51501a-06e1-4cc8-a1c4-7bd477574438?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/1d51501a-06e1-4cc8-a1c4-7bd477574438?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
If you ask me, John Sununu's decades-long record is nothing to be proud of. In case you need a refresher:
* **He holds Donald Trump 's personal endorsement: **National Republicans and Trump are backing Sununu because they know he'll line up behind their extreme agenda in the Senate.
* **His name is in the Epstein files, and he was caught lying about it:** Reports recently exposed that Sununu flat-out lied about a trip to an elite event in Doha, Qatar -- the exact same event where Jeffrey Epstein noted that "John Sununu, has good stories." Granite Staters still haven't gotten a straight answer on what else he's hiding.
* **He sold out Granite Staters to Wall Street & Big Pharma: **In Congress Sununu voted against lowering prescription drug costs, then invested in Big Pharma after leaving office. He also voted for Wall Street's $700 billion bailout, and then he got paid by a company propped up by the funds.
* **He was a lead architect of plans to privatize Social Security:** In Washington Sununu spearheaded efforts to gamble seniors' hard-earned benefits on the stock market while Wall Street profited.
* **He 's backed by right-wing dark money:** Super PACs are already pouring tens of millions into New Hampshire to prop up his campaign.
* **He can 't be trusted to look out for New Hampshire: **While Granite Staters are paying for sky-high gas and grocery prices, John Sununu is profiting.

There's a clear contrast -- but with just one week until Election Day, we're running out of time to make that case to the voters. I need your help to do it.
If we fail there's no path to a Democratic Senate majority. **But if we succeed, we can prove that New Hampshire is not for sale** -- especially not to somebody like John Sununu and the MAGA billionaires bankrolling his campaign.
**[Now is the time: Rush a $5 contribution to our campaign so we can start this final phase of the election as strongly as possible and keep New Hampshire blue.](https://substack.com/redirect/1d51501a-06e1-4cc8-a1c4-7bd477574438?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Thank you,
Chris

Friend, I’m reaching out to ask for your help because my team and I just made the difficult decision to double our end-of-month goal. We need to raise $3 million by 11:59 p.m. on Oct. 31, and **[anything you can spare would be a huge help.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142251751/656337986/-540544497?amounts=10,25,50,100,250&refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk909&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjMvMS8xMjYxMjYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTZmNTJiODItZTVkMS1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAwZDNhNGZiZDUwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=5NyvuxXhUmVTW2pa9akuyAWBhVzN0TtHCHqF2RqWmSQ=)**
Let me back up a bit. In recent weeks, a **a top GOP super PAC has diverted millions from North Carolina to launch a massive ad campaign here in Kansas in support of my opponent. And JD Vance came to Kansas to bail out Roger Marshall after his terrible debate performance._That’s how scared they are of our grassroots momentum._**
We’re fighting back with all we have, but their attempts to drown us out on the airwaves just as Kansans are starting to cast their votes may be gaining some traction. **We’ve gone from a narrow lead in the polls to a dead heat. How we respond right now will determine if we win or lose this race.**
**That’s why we had to raise our goal, and it’s why we urgently need your support today:[Please, will you chip in $10 or more now to make sure we have the resources to compete with Roger Marshall’s millions and flip this seat?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142251752/656337987/-540544497?amounts=10,25,50,100,250&refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk909&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjMvMS8xMjYxMjYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTZmNTJiODItZTVkMS1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAwZDNhNGZiZDUwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=5NyvuxXhUmVTW2pa9akuyAWBhVzN0TtHCHqF2RqWmSQ=)**
Your support is literally powering this campaign. **Every dollar you give will help us increase our ad buys, up our door-knocking and phone-banking efforts and reach Kansans far and wide when it matters most.**
| | [Donate](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142251753/656337988/-540544497?amounts=10,25,50,100,250&refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk909&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjMvMS8xMjYxMjYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTZmNTJiODItZTVkMS1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAwZDNhNGZiZDUwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=5NyvuxXhUmVTW2pa9akuyAWBhVzN0TtHCHqF2RqWmSQ=)

Experts across the country, like Nate Silver and Steve Kornacki, have shifted this race to a toss-up. That means it could go either way. If we hit our goals, keep up our momentum and finish this race in a full sprint, we can win. We can restore trust and decency in our government and begin to fix what’s broken in Washington.
On the other hand, if we fall short and let Sen. Marshall and his allies drown out our message, we could be looking at six more years of higher costs, healthcare cuts and policies that do more harm than good for Kansans. I don’t want to see that happen, and I’m sure you don’t either.

subject: This email matters more than most
body:
Here’s what Meta’s final-week ad blackout means for us.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter, I have bad news, and this one’s a little wonky, so bear with me.
**As of this morning, our campaign can’t launch a single new ad on Facebook or Instagram.**
[**Before I explain what that means, will you chip in $5 right now to help us fill the gap?**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20261027_1_meta.Ir7-HO&refcode=em20261027-2556&amount=5&t=1&akid=2556%2E299639%2EwN1km4)
Here’s what you need to know: Every election cycle, Meta blocks all new political ads for the final week of the race. **That hits our campaign in two big ways.**
**First, we can’t launch new ads to win over voters.** Whatever ads Greg Abbott already had running can keep running. But through Election Day, we can’t put out a new ad answering his attacks. We can’t respond to breaking news in this race. And we can’t adjust our message on the platforms where millions of Texans spend their time.
**Second, we can’t launch new ads to raise money.** Facebook and Instagram ads asking supporters to chip in are a real part of how we fund this campaign. This month alone, they’ve brought in more than 10% of our online fundraising. Now, right when every dollar matters most, that tool is mostly off the table.
**That means two things have to happen this week.**
_**We have to take our message everywhere Meta can’t stop us:**_ streaming TV and YouTube, digital ads on news sites and apps, and TV spots in the markets where this race will be won or lost.
_**And we have to pay for it with grassroots donations from emails like this one**_ , because email is now one of the most important fundraising tools we have left. Every dollar we raise this week goes straight into putting our message in front of the voters who will decide this race.
**[So I’m turning to you, Peter. What we raise from this email will help decide how much ground we can cover this week. Will you chip in $5 or any amount right now to help us keep our message in front of voters through Election Day?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20261027_1_meta.Ir7-HO&refcode=em20261027-2556&amount=5&t=2&akid=2556%2E299639%2EwN1km4)**

Thank you,
Gina

## Anthropic IPO Could Set Record
Anthropic officially unveiled details of its IPO to the public yesterday, setting up an offering that could value the AI company at [up to $2 trillion](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDHO2zAMhU8jbwpkKv1lDxq6eEvXjgYtUzFbRTIk2kFuX7hDL9DtIwh8eO_9fMwP5MT5-QNf5CWWOdO7JRKhOmOWrZadA--lBayfDVMqb6IZDHzp3mhwMwbhk-a-W30kArId-d6N1ozOfINu8zEYpH6I98G6AcE4DOSCDdEaG2lcOvaXrjfgemPNfbzRsLoxuGF0FB0GUHdDK0upt1-Fs2wU06ecVG-hvLrkN5G9KftdwaRgyp-9NLleCqZLrGDqzcUXLUfjTK0pmP6105ETNR1L1Usq4fdyNKGqeS9aNhQdypFWfWI6SCPrJ2MWjaJBS-WUuGQFU1f9ur-vs305dTfPF3L6G1D-b9bTw58AAAD__130jeI), topping SpaceX's June debut as the largest public offering ever. Shares will trade on the Nasdaq under the ticker ANT. The company behind the Claude AI models took in $16.3 billion in the first half of 2026, up from $1.2 billion a year earlier. It also reported an [$80.7 billion loss](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHO3CAQhJ_G7rAAn41dUKS57k-b0iJ4MRthFsGeT3776CLlCf5uik-jme_X1_blMGE-froTLAfaMrxbAmaom8scKxX0WKh5V-_oUqI3wKalnoWSQpvNecYLNtXvNgBoGHuwyqyjXI2cdB-tV2ZdJjXPcgnKKD-FMI37si5hmkE-TI_2U6ekNkqO8rEOsOxm9WZZDQTjvO4eEnZkqsMfwswRQrrpgjp4OvtkI3Np3fij089OPwNmlz0Mt4tEH6LTTwYfMyU67k4_XWX0CT7p_z9RXr8T-nSLgAmawEKiVGoFPL-ayMSYD9G4Uj5EhQvyC8RR6c1RuLyL07WGF4hWIO8fVI1qkUaNyxD5TH21e3ljSthm0z3kcTpM_8bz95RfVv8NAAD__6sKmgU), about $72 billion of which was attributable to accounting charges tied to financing deals. Anthropic has committed more than $540 billion to data centers and chip leases over the next decade. The filing also runs more than 90 pages of risk warnings, including that advanced AI could pose "catastrophic or existential [risks to humanity](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOpCAURp8GOwxeHZGCYjYTu9lmiy0NgaveWQQDzLi-_cYt_hf46y85-c75_ZyehjyF5afZUJc5TgGP7LEUTJMJZU1xJ0t7zNakczXexwNxAgE9bwQHORlb6INTUzk9IwK2FepGqlYoKW5QrdqgmrvezSh72d8QenUbXGNBdSAGaIaK9IVrBMhGtKJTNQ5OKisHJXGWxgLrBDoqMdWvSKGsOPszfjDVNm6V12spe2btncHIYDyOo95yuDYGIwb-zgzGLQY8GYwLBkzGMxi_5HjmtEce38VTwMwN8czxb0kmJkfBpJMnyn8uikn8foelfz1a1o7RkmPt48dVD4_8C9NeJe32g7yn3EvWiWUz5P_fLN-L-9HwLwAA__97W4_v)." Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley are leading the offering, with share count and pricing to be set in the coming weeks. Wall Street's target has a range from the top estimate of $2 trillion down to about $1.5 trillion amid jitters over AI spending.
## Halloween Costs Hit a Scary High
Americans are on track to spend a [record $13.5 billion](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGO5CAQBdDT4AwLyl5jBwSbOOtNN7RoKJoaYWMB08i3H3mkOcFkJZX0v97__9gehiIdr39mR1192g5sJWKtmDdz1JDTSZbOVKzJVzAxpoa4gYCJS8FBbcZWeuMmO6c9IuDQoZZqGcSixB_ogobhOc0DTta7yYzojB8FgnR-tlLISXak7zgpQEkxiHHpcXZqsWpeFHplLLBRoKOacv-R6KgBfbzSG3Nv095FHWo9Cxv-MlgZrK213j7Lzbj_DNb7ZLDadJTPHXPh3ljkN4gw8x_TwW0qtfAaqPALTeYBMxbewsVg7bJ2Z6MYqUyKjeK1G4rf_fV3q701fAUAAP__SMOEjg) on Halloween this year, the National Retail Federation reported, about $400 million more than last year and $1.9 billion more than in 2024. Candy is the sharpest squeeze. Property taxes are the biggest source in about half the states, according to the Census Bureau . New Hampshire leans hardest at 64.3%, since it has no general sales tax and no tax on wages. Florida and Texas, which also skip the income tax, rely on sales and property taxes, which together bring in about three-quarters of Florida's collections. Oil and gas states like North Dakota and Wyoming get a big chunk from instead, and Oregon, with no sales tax, leans on income taxes.
